page.overview:
Who is Karbrac?

Karbrac is a non-canon character that made his only appearance in the first episode of the Mortal Kombat cartoon series, Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm. He is the leader of the Tarkatans. In the series, it is stated that he is the "new" leader, however, it is never mentioned who the previous leader was.
